description: This file defines the Task class, a domain model representing a to-do item with properties like id, title, description, completion status, creation date, update date, and due date. It includes constructors, getters, setters, and overrides for equals and hashCode.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A domain model class representing a task or to-do item with properties for id, title, description, timestamps, and completion status.

methods.name: Task
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to create a Task with specific details.

methods.name: newTask
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Task with generated UUID and current timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the task.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the task.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Returns whether the task is completed.

methods.name: setCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion status and updates 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the task.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the task's title and updates 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the task's description and updates 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the task.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date of the task.

methods.name: setDueDate
methods.description: Sets the due date and updates 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on task ID.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on task ID.
